name: Bingles' Missing Supplies
objectiveText: Find and return Bingles' supplies: Bingles' Wrench , Bingles' Screwdriver , Bingles' Hammer , and Bingles' Blastencapper . Bingles' Wrench  ( 1 ) Bingles' Screwdriver  ( 1 ) Bingles' Hammer  ( 1 ) Bingles' Blastencapper  ( 1 )

Bingles tools are located in Trogg camps on the 2 northern islands in the Loch.  The large island has three seperate camps (two small and one large in the middle) that have one piece each.  They are not drops but instead stuff you pick up off the ground.  THEY ARE SMALL SO LOOK CAREFULLY!

The wrench is located inside Bingles Toolbox on the small island adjacent to the large one.  This island is tricky solo.  Recommend at least 4 people take this cause generally there are 3-4 Trogg Seers (casters) and 3-4 skullthumpers (warriors that stun like crazy).  Best to start from the northern tip of the small island and take out their sentry(s) first then move to the camp.

Bingle's tools are at these locations:

Wrench:  49, 30 https://www.wowhead.com/forever/object=104564
Screwdriver: 48, 20
Hammer: 52, 24
Blastencapper: 54, 27 https://www.wowhead.com/forever/object=104575

Little tricky for my lvl 15 paladin with the bonecrushers running into other mobs.  The 1050 exp made it totally worth it

Screwdriver : /tloc 48,20 
In the northwestest camp.
Has some spellcasters. No big problem with strong fireattacks. Choose first mobs outside camp, then inside camp. First item is then possible.

Wrench : /tloc 49,30 
Little place in the southwest island.
Kill first some mobs outside camp.
Then kill Seer (spellcaster), use sheep on second mob. First dead. Haven't kill Seer fast enough, 3rd mob comes already, and i'm double-stunned, cannot drink quickly. Dead.
Comes back, lucky Seer is dead. Now 2 mobs over. Pull one, another comes too. Use sheep cast at one mob, because they stunned me too much. Now i have second item. 

Blast : /tloc 54,27 
Most southeastest camp.
More work, pulling one result in 1 extra mob, use sheep if possible
Must eat and drink many times for recovering mana and health. Use fire mainly and frost sometimes.
Third item is possible. (by the entrance of the tent)

Hammer : /tloc 52,24 
Little north from east camp.
Near the damaged wood wagon. Pulling 1 to 1 is here possible. Ignore the camp near, kill only mobs around damaged vehicles. Fourth item is now possible.

This is possible at level 14. Just need to have patience. Time the MOBS as they walk. If you pull more than two at any time then run. Running away is not a bad thing. 

Rules: 
1) Have a clear escape route.

2) Take the time to watch everyones movements. MOBs move around between bases and you can be safe if you wait for them to move away, safer when they are looking away. When they come back and the area is clear, take them out too, avoid surprises.

3) Be careful of hidden MOBS behind boxes and things. If you get an extra that you did not plan for then run. It is the brave thing to do.

4) Keep a clear path open. Always check for respawns.

5) Fights, there are only 2 mobs you have to worry about, the Seers and the Shamans. The others are easy, even lvl 16s. with the Seers, move away once you pull them, get them to run after you so they are far away from their mates. Not too far as they will disengage. Distance avoids extra pulls. Do not let them run when almost dead. Keep your intant big hit stuff for last. The Shamans are easy, but you need some way to interrupt them. When they start showing a green heal magic, they are ready to heal, stop them, they will try this only once. If they heal, no problem just keep at it. Takes longer but they will not heal twice. Always take out the Seers and Shamans first. 

6) If you pull two MOBs, finish off one, see if you have enough to take out the other, or run. Remember it hurts more when hit in the back, so be careful. Bring some potions. 

7) Keep your back door open. A few times I had to run and got away by the skin of my teeth. When you have to go in the water, remember the fish bite, small hits but a lot.

8) Clear all the MOBS before going for the gear. Some are triggered by the activation. Always heal and buff before opening anything. Check escape roots. 

8) The hardest of the camps is the middle of the island. Make sure you know where you are starting from and do not spend too much time, or else you will have respawns. Kill everything you can, to be safe, but only as much as needed. Killing the island clean does not help due to respawns, just clear a safe Zone.

I took my lvl 18 human warrior up the Loch looking for the wayward gnome's gear. The Troggs on the islands gave me a warm reception, and appeared to have built several fires to more quickly cook the meal they anticipated. I found that if I stayed near the water I could pick my battles and create an area of relative safety. Near each of the fires I noted the gnome's tools.

Those who can absorb damage and know when to run may find the following tactic useful. After clearing a beach-head in the direction of probable retreat (for the items on north island, there was usually a nice close retreat northward to the relative safety of the Loch), target a Trogg whose path or post would make it impossible to open the toolboxes. Focus all your effort on killing that one. Others may aggro, as noted here by others. Still, focus and kill that one. Preference should be given to Shamans, who will throw near-complete heals when they are about 2/3 dead. If you have a spell-interruption skill, make sure you keep it handy. Now retreat into the water and let any adds lose interest in you (there are a few level 15ish mobs north of the island, such as Frenzies, but they can be avoided for the most part).

Return to shore and approach your toolbox again. Repeat the above method if any Trogg is too close to loot the box. If you apply this technique well, 2 or 3 repetitions will clear a patch around the box you can finally approach carefully and loot without interruption.

It is certainly advisable to bring along a few potions of healing, of course. Good luck!

Ok,

  A little more info on this quest.  Bring a group, even someone level 23ish will have a tough time soloing here because of the adds. A group of 16's will have a time of it as well, respawns can come quickly so be quick in getting items.  Everyone needs to loot their own, so a well oiled group needs to hold a camp long enough for 5 successive Bingle tool spawns.  It may be best to start on south island to get warmed up before going to the more populated north island.
